_schema.format: object map: criticSlug -> { bww?, nysun?, nysr?, nyt?, newyorker?, vulture? } (all optional strings)
_schema.purpose: Override author-page slugs for sources where the registry slug doesn't match the source's URL. Loaded by audit-critic-coverage.js (S1-T7, BRO-52).
_schema.case-sensitive: BWW slugs MUST preserve case (e.g. Elysa-Gardner) — lowercase 404s
_schema.nyt: nytimes.com/by/{slug} — single page only, no query-param pagination
_schema.newyorker: newyorker.com/contributors/{slug} — single page only, no query-param pagination
_schema.vulture: vulture.com/author/{slug} — single page only, no query-param pagination
_schema.see-also: Sprint S1-T2 in sprint-plan-critic-coverage.md; BRO-52 added nyt/newyorker/vulture
_schema._comment: Keys starting with _ are ignored when iterating critic entries
